what: On hover, the one-line uppercase text in an outlined pill button rolls up in .3s and a second copy of the same text stands in its place, while the two arrows in the black circle on the right slide right together — the visible arrow leaves and the hidden left arrow comes in (.3s outQuad). The border fades straight to .4 in .5s. On release it returns the same way

options.line: Edge blur length (seconds), default .5 — 0 leaves the edge as is
options.--fx-ink · --fx-dot · --fx-dot-ink: Text·border, circle, and arrow-in-circle colors (via style), default var(--kf-ink) · var(--kf-ink) · var(--kf-bg)
options.[data-fx-part=roll]: Rolling text cell — the first line (span) inside shows and the second line rises (if there is no second line, the motion part clones it)
options.[data-fx-part=arrow]: (optional) circle — if there is one svg arrow inside, the part builds one more set

from.where: shared.js .ms-btn (pill buttons like ”See more About” and ”See all Work” — original Button IN / OUT, button_text -100% · small-arrow -50% → 100% · border alpha 1 → .4)
